# Find initial Level 2 state in history
for entry in history:
    if entry.frame.level == 2 and entry.frame.step < 100:

        seg = entry.frame.segmentation
        for n in seg['nodes']:
            if n['color'] in ['c', 'Y', 'S', 'B']:
                if n['pixels'] > 10:
                    b = n['boundary']
                    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
                    cols = [p[1] for p in b]

print("All objects:")
for n in seg['nodes']:

        b = n['boundary']

        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: pixels={n['pixels']} rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)} hash={n['hash']}")

# Check dark gray shape in detail
c_obj = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c'][0]
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

for r in range(c_obj['boundary'][0][0], c_obj['boundary'][-1][0] + 1):
    row_str = ascii_lines[r]
    c_positions = [i for i, ch in enumerate(row_str) if ch == 'c']
    if c_positions:
        print(f"  Row {r}: cols {min(c_positions)}-{max(c_positions)} ({len(c_positions)} cells)")

print(f"\nYellow shape (rows {y_obj['boundary'][0][0]}-{y_obj['boundary'][-1][0]}):")
for r in range(y_obj['boundary'][0][0], y_obj['boundary'][-1][0] + 1):

    y_positions = [i for i, ch in enumerate(row_str) if ch == 'Y']
